widgets.title: How leads, stages and discounts are decided

config.html:
• CRM lead routing: hot leads (score 80+) go to the strategic desk; the rest by region and company size (1,000+ employees is enterprise). It sets the territory, owner and response time.
  • Lead score: source (referral 30, partner 25, events 20, website 15) + company size (up to 30) + seniority (25 for VP, head, director or chief).
  • CRM stage rules: each stage’s probability, forecast category and the task the rep gets.
  • CRM discount authority: over 20% or $100,000 needs the sales manager and the VP; over 10% the sales manager.

Edit them under Automations → Decision tables; the workflows pick up changes at once.

config.html:
1. Share the app: Settings → Audience. Sales reps as contributors; leadership as viewers (read-only Insights and pipeline).
  2. Replace the sample owners (Alex Morgan, Maya Patel…) with your reps’ names in CRM accounts, deals and leads, and in the CRM lead routing table.
  3. Publish the Website lead form with a public link (Forms → Website lead → Share) and put it on your site.
  4. Check who receives each step: lead qualification, VP approval, customer success kickoff and renewal calls.
  5. Optional: choose an AI provider on the CRM account assistant agent to switch on deal summaries and welcome-email drafts.
  6. Delete the sample rows when you go live.
